chunks: Or do they want to stage a deception? -- Then only those who do not believe will be the ones who will be tricked.

key_terms.الْمَكِيدُونَ: the ones who will be tricked/deceived

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Makidun' in Surah Al-Mudathir?
ai.summary: In the context of the Makkan period, this verse responds to the Quraysh's political and social maneuvers against the Prophet Muhammad, asserting that their intricate plots will ultimately rebound upon them. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a divine guarantee of the Prophet's protection, emphasizing that the disbelievers' own disbelief becomes the mechanism of their undoing.
